<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" ana="corpusmd:the_tshom" xml:id="ex112_2023_05_08" status="reviewed">des na don du myi 'gyur ba'i the tsoM 'jug pa'i <choice><corr>yan</corr><sic>yang</sic></choice> lag sngar yod pas don du 'gyur ba'i the tsoM nyid myi dgos pa dang | don du myi 'gyur ba'i the tsoM ldog pa'i yan lag gzhan sngar gnas pa yang bzlog par myi nus pas dgos 'brel kyi ngag don myed do zhe na |
         de ni bden te <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:3786">bdag cag</rs> dgos 'brel kyi ngag 'jug pa'i yan lag du khas <expan>len to</expan> || <pb n="4a"/><lb n="4a1"/> 'on kyang 'dir ni <rs type="person" ref="db:3780" ana="corpusmd:named_reference"> slob dpon chos mchog</rs> gi bzhed pa tsaM bkod pa yin la de'i 'dod pas kyang don du 'gyur ba'i the tsoM don la shas cher rtog pa la 'dod do || de yang myi 'thad pa ni dngos po'i nyes pa yin bas 'di ci byar yod |</seg></TEI>
